findings.title: Normalize hostnames before comparing domains
findings.body: DNS hostnames are case-insensitive, but this comparison is case-sensitive. If a user enters `https://EXAMPLE.COM/user` while the instance hostname is `example.com`, the serializer treats them as different domains and returns only `EXAMPLE.COM` instead of the complete path. Normalize both hostnames before the domain comparisons so the feature works for valid URLs with uppercase hostnames.
